Dove Soft IPO Details

Bookbuilding IPO | ₹73 Cr | Listing at BSE SME | Wed, Sep 30, 2026 - Mon, Oct 5, 2026

Dove Soft IPO is a book build issue of ₹73.26 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 53.28 lakh shares aggregating to ₹59.14 crores and offer for sale of 12.72 lakh shares aggregating to ₹14.12 crores.

Dove Soft IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Dove Soft IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Dove Soft IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Dove Soft IPO is set issue price band at ₹104 to ₹111 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,66,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,99,600.

Swastika Investmart Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Purva Sharegistry (India) Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Swastika Investmart Ltd.

Refer to Dove Soft IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About Dove Soft Ltd.

Updated on Sep 24, 2026

Incorporated in August 2011, Dove Soft Limited provides integrated cloud-communication solutions through SMS, RCS, Voice, WhatsApp, Email, and other digital channels. The company provides services to enterprises and OTT platforms, including SMS, WhatsApp, Voice, IVR, automated calls, E-mail, and Digital Products. The company serves clients across industries like Telecom, IT, Travel, Entertainment, Media, Advertising, Retail, Real Estate, Healthcare, BFSI, Automobile, E-commerce, and Food & Beverages, helping manage customer communication and streamline operations.

Services:

  • Enterprise Messaging Services: Bulk SMS, transactional and promotional SMS, and OTP delivery.
  • Voice Solutions: Automated IVR, outbound dialer services, and missed call alerts.
  • Email Marketing Solutions: High-volume enterprise-grade email delivery infrastructure.
  • WhatsApp Business API: Secure and scalable customer engagement via WhatsApp for notifications, support, and marketing.

The company cloud-based delivery platform enables them to build and manage applications without having to create and maintain the underlying infrastructure for each client. It enables them to provide enterprises with solutions to operate applications without purchasing, configuring or managing the underlying hardware and software.

As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 92 people in various departments.

Competitive Strength:

  • Sustainable business model and consistent financial track record.
  • Diversified service portfolio resulting in our lesser dependence on a single industry, product or services.
  • Scalable delivery platform supported by robust infrastructure.
  • Experienced Promoter and senior management team.

IPO FAQs

Dove Soft IPO is a SME IPO of 66,00,000 equity shares of the face value of ₹10 aggregating up to ₹73 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹104 to ₹111. The minimum order quantity is 1200.

The IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026, and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

Purva Sharegistry (India) Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO. The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE SME.

Zerodha customers can apply online in Dove Soft IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Dove Soft IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form.

Steps to apply in Dove Soft IPO through Zerodha

  1. Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console.
  2. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link.
  3. Go to the 'Dove Soft IPO' row and click the 'Bid' button.
  4. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price.
  5. Submit IPO application form.
  6. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM) to approve the mandate.

Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

The Dove Soft IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

Dove Soft IPO lot size is 1200, and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,66,400, with 2 lots being the minimum application size.

You can apply in Dove Soft IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha, Upstox, 5Paisa, Nuvama, HDFC Bank, and SBI Bank.

The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Dove Soft IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026. Check the Dove Soft IPO allotment status.

The Dove Soft IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 8, 2026.
